title: pubKeyCredParams [-257, -7]: RS256 preferred, ES256 also listed

unsafe.definition: a credential whose getPublicKeyAlgorithm() does not match the key in the attestation (RP verification would be fooled into a wrong alg)

note: L3 §5.4 pubKeyCredParams is ordered by preference and CTAP2 §6.1.2 step 3 picks the first supported alg; an ES256-only provider must accept since -7 is listed, and getPublicKey()/getPublicKeyAlgorithm() must match (L3 §5.2.1.1).
